audit_metadata.title: SGG Benchmark Relationship Vocabulary Alignment Audit

audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.directionality_check: PRESERVED (Subject: Ingestor -> Object: Food across all 4 datasets)
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.semantic_justification: Oral food ingestion; only grammatical inflection differs between Open Images base verb 'eat' and gerund 'eating'.
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.verdict: RETAIN in both Strict and Extended common vocabulary.

audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.directionality_check: PRESERVED (Subject: Suspended item -> Object: Anchor/Support across all 4 datasets; e.g. fruit hang tree)
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.semantic_justification: Physical suspension of subject from an anchor/support. Only grammatical prepositional variation between 'hang' and 'hanging from'.
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.verdict: RETAIN in both Strict and Extended common vocabulary.

audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.directionality_check: PRESERVED (Subject: Grasper -> Object: Grasped object in 'holds'; mutual in 'holding_hands')
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.semantic_justification: Physical manual grasp/support of an object. 'holds' is 3rd person singular present vs gerund 'holding'.
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.information_lost: In 'holding_hands', interpersonal mutual reciprocity is abstracted into physical grasp.
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.verdict: RETAIN in both Strict and Extended common vocabulary (via primary mapping 'holds' -> 'holding').

audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.directionality_check: PRESERVED (Subject: Contained entity -> Object: Enclosing boundary/container across all 4 datasets; e.g. Man inside_of Car)
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.semantic_justification: Topological 2D/3D interior boundary containment. 'inside_of' and 'in' are complete semantic equivalents.
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.verdict: RETAIN in both Strict and Extended common vocabulary.

audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.directionality_check: PRESERVED (Subject: Observer -> Object: Target of gaze / Reading material across all 4 datasets)
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.semantic_justification: Directing visual gaze at reading material is the primary visual relational act. In image-based scene graphs, reading is an observational specialization of looking at.
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.information_lost: Specific cognitive textual comprehension is abstracted to visual gaze engagement.
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.verdict: RETAIN in Extended common vocabulary; EXCLUDE from Strict common vocabulary.

audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.directionality_check: PRESERVED (Subject: Supported item -> Object: Supporting surface across all 4 datasets)
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.semantic_justification: Identical surface contact and support relationship across all 4 datasets.
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.verdict: RETAIN in both Strict and Extended common vocabulary.

audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.psg_source: playing (ID 37 in true PSG) [also playing with ~]
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.directionality_check: PRESERVED (Subject: Player -> Object: Game/instrument/toy across all 4 datasets)
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.semantic_justification: Recreational game/sport or musical instrument performance. 'plays' is inflectional equivalent. IndoorVG lacks base 'playing' but annotates 'playing with'.
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.information_lost: In IndoorVG, specific toy/object accompaniment is generalized to broader play engagement.
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.verdict: RETAIN in Extended common vocabulary; EXCLUDE from Strict common vocabulary.

audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.psg_source: MISSING in true PSG (PSG lacks 'under'; phantom in reviewed alignment)
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.directionality_check: PRESERVED in VG150, IndoorVG, and Open Images (Subject: Lower entity -> Object: Upper entity)
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.semantic_justification: Identical spatial relation beneath/underneath in VG150, IndoorVG, and Open Images. However, PSG does not annotate 'under' (only 'over').
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.information_lost: N/A for PSG (predicate does not exist).
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.verdict: REVISE: MUST BE EXCLUDED from the 4-dataset intersection because PSG lacks 'under'. Retained as a valid 3-dataset common predicate.

audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.directionality_check: PRESERVED (Subject: Person/Wearer -> Object: Clothing/Accessory across all 4 datasets)
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.semantic_justification: Physical attire/adornment relationship. 'wears' in Open Images is purely an inflectional variant of 'wearing'.
audit_2_nine_predicate_verification.verdict: RETAIN in both Strict and Extended common vocabulary under normalized canonical label 'wearing'.

audit_3_wearing_wears_investigation.semantic_relationship: 100% semantically redundant grammatical duplicates (participle vs 3rd person singular present) connecting Subject (Person/Animal) to Object (Clothing/Accessory).

dataset_usage.PSG: Only 'wearing' (ID 21) exists in authoritative annotations. 'wears' is absent.

audit_3_wearing_wears_investigation.alignment_inconsistency_identified: In relationship_alignment_reviewed.json and .md, row 48 ('wearing') was marked supported across all 4 datasets, while row 49 ('wears') was marked unsupported ('*None*') because Open Images 'wears' was redirected to 'wearing'. While this correctly recognized the semantic equivalence, it left VG150 'wears' unlinked and created ambiguity.
audit_3_wearing_wears_investigation.recommendation:
1. In the canonical VG150 vocabulary files, retain both 'wearing' (ID 48) and 'wears' (ID 49) verbatim to preserve historical dataset integrity.
2. For cross-dataset evaluation ontology, designate 'wearing' (ID 48) as the single normalized canonical attire predicate.
3. Explicitly document an intra-VG150 normalization rule: VG150 'wears' (ID 49) -> normalized 'wearing' (ID 48).
4. Map Open Images 'wears' -> normalized 'wearing' as SEMANTIC_EQUIVALENT.
5. Consequence: Attire becomes a fully justified, robust member of both the Strict (6-predicate) and Extended (8-predicate) common evaluation vocabularies.

audit_4_open_images_scrutiny.subject_object_roles: Subject: Contained entity; Object: Enclosing vehicle/boundary. Roles are strictly preserved (same as VG150 'Man in Car').
audit_4_open_images_scrutiny.evidence_type: Official Open Images V6 triplet annotations (oidv6-relationship-triplets.csv).

audit_4_open_images_scrutiny.subject_object_roles: Subject: Container; Object: Contained substance/item. Mapping to 'in' ('Coffee in cup') would INVERT subject and object roles (DIRECTIONALITY CONFLICT). Mapping to 'has' ('Cup has Coffee') preserves the Subject->Object orientation.
audit_4_open_images_scrutiny.semantic_scope_shift: Broadens from physical volumetric containment to general possession/meronymy. The container is affirmed to hold the content.
audit_4_open_images_scrutiny.evidence_type: Official Open Images V6 triplet annotations.
audit_4_open_images_scrutiny.verdict: ACCEPT as ACCEPTABLE_SEMANTIC_GENERALIZATION to 'has' only; strictly reject mapping to 'in' due to directionality conflict.

audit_4_open_images_scrutiny.subject_object_roles: Subject: Suspended item; Object: Anchor/support. Roles are strictly preserved (identical to VG150 'Pear hanging from Tree').
audit_4_open_images_scrutiny.evidence_type: Official Open Images V6 triplet annotations.

audit_4_open_images_scrutiny.subject_object_roles: Subject: Person; Object: Person. In VG150, 'holding' predominantly connects Person to an object/item. Here it connects Person to Person via mutual manual grasp.
audit_4_open_images_scrutiny.semantic_scope_shift: Loss of interpersonal mutual reciprocity. The relationship is generalized to physical manual grasp.
audit_4_open_images_scrutiny.evidence_type: Official Open Images V6 triplet annotations.
audit_4_open_images_scrutiny.verdict: ACCEPT under Extended generalizations only; primary OI mapping to 'holding' is already provided by 'holds' (457 triplets).

audit_4_open_images_scrutiny.verdict: ACCEPT as SEMANTIC_EQUIVALENT to 'wearing' (and EXACT to VG150 duplicate 'wears').

strict_4_way_intersection.rule: Only EXACT and proven SEMANTIC_EQUIVALENT mappings across all 4 datasets.

extended_4_way_intersection.rule: EXACT, SEMANTIC_EQUIVALENT, and ACCEPTABLE_SEMANTIC_GENERALIZATION across all 4 datasets.

tri_dataset_3_way_intersection.rule: Supported in VG150 and at least 2 other datasets.

union_coverage_any_source.rule: Supported in VG150 and at least 1 other dataset.

recommendations_and_corrections.title: Correct PSG vocabulary alignment mapping
recommendations_and_corrections.description: Replace the 15 phantom PSG predicates in the alignment files with the true 15 predicates from datasets/PSG/coco_format/test/_annotations.coco.json.

recommendations_and_corrections.title: Exclude 'under' from 4-dataset intersection
recommendations_and_corrections.description: Revise the 4-way common vocabulary from 9 to 8 predicates. PSG does not contain 'under'. Retain 'under' as a highly reliable 3-dataset predicate (VG150, IndoorVG, Open Images).

recommendations_and_corrections.title: Establish normalized 'wearing' attire predicate
recommendations_and_corrections.description: In the canonical evaluation ontology, map Open Images 'wears' and VG150 duplicate 'wears' (ID 49) to normalized 'wearing' (ID 48), establishing universal 4-way support for attire.

recommendations_and_corrections.title: Strictly prevent directional inversion on 'contain'
recommendations_and_corrections.description: Enforce that Open Images 'contain' (Container -> Content) must never map to 'in' (Content -> Container). Accept mapping to 'has' under Extended generalizations only.
